title: The person your dog waits for
mechanism: Test whether a recognizable daily greeting and the real blanket make someone send the film to their partner.

scenes.headline: For the person your dog waits for.
scenes.text: A word-free sherpa blanket, painted from your dog's photo.

scenes.headline: Your dog loves you too.
